chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al-Mufazzal ibn Salih, from Lays Al-Murady, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the man who comes to Makkah during the days of Mina, after finishing the visitation of the House, then he performs Tawaf of the House voluntarily. He said: 'Staying in Mina is superior and more beloved to me (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a plain near Mecca where pilgrims stay during Hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it better to stay in Mina or perform voluntary Tawaf during the days of Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the ritual hierarchy during the days of Hajj, prioritizing the prescribed stay in Mina over voluntary Tawaf. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on adhering to the specific temporal and spatial obligations of Hajj rituals, where the 'staying' (Muqamah) in Mina holds greater spiritual weight than additional circumambulations once the core rites are fulfilled. It reflects the principle that fulfilling the Sunnah of the Prophet in its designated time and place takes precedence over supererogatory acts.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Lays Al Murady who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the man who came to Makkah during the days of Mina, after his being free from visitation of the House (Kabah), then he performed Tawaaf of the House (Kabah) voluntarily. So, heasws said: ‘The staying in Mina is superior and more beloved to measws’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Layth al-Muradiy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who comes to Makkah in the days of Mina 5 after visiting the House, and performs Tawaf around the House optionally. He (the Imam) said, ‘Remaining in Mina’ is better and more beloved to me/”
